The '''Valley of Rejection''' was a valley that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[N'zoth]], about 300 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] to the west of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Giat Nor]]. Desolate and hot, the valley was 220 kilometers long, and off-worlders and disgraced members of the [[Yevetha]] [[Species/Legends|species]] were often exiled there as a punishment. While the banished Yevetha were only exiled to the valley after the performance of a number of ceremonies and rituals, off-worlders sent to the valley were merely transported there in [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]] and thrown out. Despite the unforgiving landscape, a small community of off-worlders eventually established a settlement in the valley called [[Werstilhere]], where they were able to eke out an existence.<ref name="CCW" />
